```plato
    //==
    // # Containment, nearest point, and support mapping
    //
    // Bodies for the IContainsPoint2D / 3D, INearestPoint2D / 3D and ISupport2D /
    // 3D interfaces declared in `geometry.concepts.plato`. Distances are computed
    // as the magnitude of a Between delta, so the argument order of Between never
    // affects a distance result.

    //==
    // # IContainsPoint2D / IContainsPoint3D
    //
    // Membership conveniences built on Contains(point). A batched ContainsAll over
    // an Array<Point> is the fold interface-gap noted at the top of the file.

    // True when the point is NOT a member of the shape.
    Excludes(self: IContainsPoint2D, point: Point2D): Boolean
        => self.Contains(point).Not;
```
